posts.spokenScript: Single-chat AI interaction is dead. If you are still prompting AI in isolated browser tabs, you are renting intelligence instead of owning a system. In this flagship piece, we unpack how to build a sovereign control plane: isolating agents into dedicated worktrees, enforcing a 4-fact git contract, and running 19 subagents in harmony without memory corruption.
